description: Every power- and torque-quantity input and result row (HP, WHP, kW, lb-ft, N·m, ft-lbs, and the power-based ratios) of the 696 calculators, scanned in Imperial and in Metric at default state, and classified against the platform unit convention locked in on 2026-10-13 (GH-IMP-013 philosophy, GH-IMP-019 plan). cls: engine-power = gasoline / diesel engine power (default HP in both systems); engine-torque = engine torque (default lb-ft in both systems); ev-power = EV motor / electric powertrain / battery power (default kW in both systems); ev-torque = EV motor torque (default lb-ft under the current convention); driveline-torque, road-load-power = rows whose engine-versus-component reading needs owner confirmation (conf = confirm); component-torque (fasteners, brakes, bearings, yaw moment) and non-engine-power (pumps, tire heat) = retained as system-governed (N·m / kW in Metric); converter = a converter's own result row, named for its own unit; engine-derived, power-to-weight, hybrid-engine-power, road-load-derived = ratios and splits built on power that need a decision (conf = decision), most of them the BSFC family. conflict = true when the current Metric behaviour differs from the intended one; imperial_now / metric_now are the units shown today, imperial_intended / metric_intended the units the convention calls for (null = decision needed). READ-ONLY INVENTORY: no calculator behaviour is changed by this file, and no test reads it yet. It is the evidence for GH-IMP-019 and the row list its regression test would pin. Generated from the engine at HEAD f2d8fb4 plus the GH-IMP-013 D1/D2 declarations.
